notes:
Summary: Lumen Guard builds a realtime recommendation and fraud-detection layer for digital payments. Extremely latency-sensitive: primary user flows need sub-50ms server-side p95 for short prompts, tail matters (99th). Cost is critical — currently estimating $0.30–0.60 per 1k requests budget for model infra. Interested in Redwood for predictable throughput and runtime optimizations.

Conversation highlights:
- 2025-01-29 kickoff: AE (Ava) + SE (Ravi) demoed Dedicated + Optimize. Lumen team: CTO (Marcos R.), Head of ML (Elena V.), Infra lead (Samir).
- "If p95 spikes above 50ms we bleed conversions" — quote from Elena on call.
- POC ask: 72-hour benchmark replaying real production traces (~200 req/s sustained, spikes to 800 req/s for 30s every 5m). Measure p50/p95/p99, token/sec, and cost per 1M tokens.
- Key technical asks: support for prefix/KV cache warming, per-route batching policies, and fallback routing to a quantized small model when capacity constrained.
- Accuracy tolerance: <=2% AUC drop for fraud model when using 8-bit/4-bit quantized variant.
- Security: must integrate with company KMS (AWS KMS + HSM planned), SSO via SAML, full audit logs retained 13 months, and EU data residency for EU customers.
- Deployment preference: Private control plane in VPC (initial), possibility to move to Dedicated (Redwood-managed) for long-term economics.
- Benchmark deliverables requested: CSV of token latency distribution, breakdown by model variant (fp16, int8, 4-bit), recommendations on batch sizes and cache TTLs per route, and estimated cost delta.

CRM-style notes / shorthand:
- POC infra: want 3x GPU workers (A100 -> eval perf) + 2x fallback quantized nodes. SE to provide perf matrix.
- Trial keys provided 2025-02-03; initial smoke tests passed.
- Security questionnaire submitted 2025-01-31 — need SOC2 cert copy (have), ISO request pending.
- Quote requested for committed reserved capacity vs burst pricing.
- Elena: "Show me the p95 curve under burst; don't hide cold-starts."
- Concern: how prefix cache TTL interacts w/ privacy retention rules.

Decision criteria (stated by Lumen):
1) Proven p95 <50ms on their traces for chat/recommendation flows.
2) Clear quantization profile with accuracy/cost tradeoff.
3) VPC/private deployment + KMS + audit logs.
4) Cost predictability and fallbacks for peak traffic.

POC success metrics:
- p95 <50ms for primary route across 72-hr run, <=2% AUC drop for quantized fraud model, cost <= target band.

Sales/ops notes:
- AE to send updated pricing deck (drive link above) and reserved capacity term sheet.
- SE (Ravi) to run baseline perf (fp16) and two quantized configs (int8, 4-bit) using their trace by 2025-02-12.
- Security to schedule SAML scoping call with Redwood security by 2025-02-10.
